question: In what luminous darkness do those who have attained all powers move freely?
premises: The setting is brilliant like a stream of dark clouds
The beings described have attained all powers
inference: Those who have attained all powers move freely within a radiance resembling dark cloud streams.
uncertainties: This verse fragment may connect syntactically with the following verse.
plain_english: At will, among those who have attained all powers, in a brilliance like a stream of dark clouds...
